name: Millan Ruka
description: Millan Ruka’s PLACE19 abstract describes Environment River Patrol – Aotearoa, established in 2010, using topographic mapping and Google Earth in environmental reporting. It distinguishes that existing river-assessment work from a proposed digital nitrate-sensor project.
